run_decode_attention_fwd: run decode_attention_fwd to compute memory-efficient attention for decoding with grouped multi-head attention
run_decode_attention_fwd_normal: run decode_attention_fwd_normal to compute attention for multi-head attention (kv_group_num == 1) with logit capping and xAI temperature scaling
run_decode_attention_fwd_grouped: run decode_attention_fwd_grouped to compute attention for grouped or multi-query attention with block-head grouping optimization
run_decode_softmax_reducev_fwd: run decode_softmax_reducev_fwd to reduce intermediate attention outputs across KV splits into final output with optional sink token support
test_decode_attention_fwd: test decode_attention_fwd with q, k_buffer, v_buffer tensors, kv_indptr, kv_indices, and scaling parameters for MHA and GQA modes
